detail.command:
set -e
printf '\n=== STRUCTURE ===\n'
test -f src/courses/data/chaos-dimension.ts
count=$(grep -o "id: 'chaos-[0-9][0-9]'" src/courses/data/chaos-dimension.ts | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
test "$count" = "9"
printf 'holes=%s\n' "$count"
printf '\n=== TYPECHECK ===\n'
npm run typecheck
printf '\n=== BUILD ===\n'
npm run build
printf '\n=== STATUS ===\n'
git status --short
